title: Fix bugs in Python temperature conversion functions
description: Brownfield Python dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in temperature conversions (C-to-F uses wrong constant, F-to-C uses wrong formula, C-to-K subtracts instead of adds offset).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/tempconv.py.

Bug 1 — celsius_to_fahrenheit: uses +30 instead of +32.
  Fix: return c * 9 / 5 + 32

Bug 2 — fahrenheit_to_celsius: wrong order of operations.
  Fix: return (f - 32) * 5 / 9

Bug 3 — celsius_to_kelvin: subtracts 273.15 instead of adding.
  Fix: return c + 273.15

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.tempconv import celsius_to_fahrenheit" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.tempconv import celsius_to_fahrenheit"
